payload.reason: M2.1-IMPLEMENT-001 Slice 1 is architecturally accepted. The implementation establishes the approved R21 Major Project schema and Eloquent model parity within the reported whitelist, with no unrelated application changes and the User.php boundary preserved. The migration defines the two required R21 Major Project tables, the two Eloquent models provide the reported fillable attributes, casts, and relationships, and the dedicated test suite provides explicit coverage of model and migration structure. Focused verification passes with 5 tests and 61 assertions, the full suite passes with 13 tests and 80 assertions, and all four changed files pass PHP syntax validation. The implementation also remains consistent with the mandatory CampusLynk architectural and design-system directive: this slice contains no UI implementation, while subsequent UI work must reuse the established Master Shells and global x-ui components and must not introduce duplicated controls or styling. Slice 1 therefore satisfies its approved scope and may advance to the next controlled implementation stage.
